items.headline: Private-credit firms' insurance arms could push AI loan losses onto taxpayers via state guaranty funds, report warns; Michael Burry amplifies
items.note: Traces how PE-owned life insurers hold opaque, AI-data-center-linked credit instruments and could be backstopped by state guaranty funds if they fail — a structural tail-risk argument for the private-credit leg of the AI debt build-out, not a realized event.
